notes.title: Dawnbreaker Aeon’s Reach - Official Release Date
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40632021/9a9cd0468d50aebb0836a5f87a2428390a91c24e.png[/img]

[b]CrazySky3D[/b]’s new Visual Novel, [b]Dawnbreaker - Aeon’s Reach[/b] will launch on Steam for Windows and Linux on [b]November 5th[/b] 2021.

[b]Dawnbreaker - Aeon's Reach[/b] is an erotic visual novel that puts you in the heels of a jaded bounty hunter looking for fun, causing her to embark on a very hot cosmic adventure with a bunch of outlaws. Will you be able to find what you desire in this universe?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40632021/cfa7210538d726ec4b33737edc30ad2bd5c4295e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]A lewd story around 50k+ words long (from 5 to 6 hours of gameplay)
[*]Multiple paths with several different endings
[*]A whole cast of sensual girls for you to meet
[*]4k high-quality graphics
[*]300+ unique CGs with animations
[*]Detailed 3D backgrounds with multiple variations
[*]Image gallery, music room, and replay scene functionality
[*]Achievements, Easter eggs, and more!
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1631790/
